name: Coffin Valley
summary:
The town is Coffin Valley. Tales about this cutthroat place have spread all throughout the neighboring land. The sheriff put out an advertisement looking for a new deputy...who knows what happened to the last one.

Are you brave enough to explore Coffin Valley? Do you have the guts, determination, and willpower to solve what evils lurk within this town. Will you rise up to become the Sheriff's right hand man?
